empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? Agents using it lose the rule.

config.heading: Configuration
config.bodyHint: Markdown. Sent to the reviewing agent exactly as written.
config.summaryHint: Optional — shown in the version history.

projectContext.heading: Project context to use
projectContext.hint: Documents attached here are read into every review run by every agent that uses this skill — configure the pairing once and each agent inherits it. Earlier documents appear earlier in the assembled prompt, and every change is saved as you make it.
projectContext.noRepo: Pick a repository in the top bar to attach its documents.
projectContext.discoveryError: Couldn’t scan the repository clone. Attached documents are still listed and can be detached.
projectContext.noClone: This repository has no clone on disk, so nothing was discovered. Attached documents are still listed.
projectContext.empty: No documents found. Discovery reads .md files under the repository's configured context roots.
projectContext.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the attached documents. Nothing was changed.
projectContext.saveConflict: These documents changed somewhere else while you were editing, so nothing was saved. The list below is the current one — make the change again.

row.beyondCap: Not read: only 20 documents are read per run

serialized.label: SERIALIZES AS
serialized.hint: Exactly what a review run sends for this skill: the same heading, and each document wrapped as untrusted data.
serialized.empty: Nothing is attached, so no project-context section is sent.
serialized.unreadHint: These attachments are named in the run trace instead of being sent.

stats.empty: Not used by any agent yet
stats.emptyHint: Attach it from an agent's Skills tab.
stats.loadError: Could not load usage for this skill.

versions.heading: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body, so a review can be traced to the exact text it ran on.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This adds a new version with that body.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.

previewTab.heading: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.empty: This skill has no body yet.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Write the rule yourself, or import a Markdown file from your machine

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.
file.descriptionHint: Optional — one line, shown on the card.
file.pickFileHint: Read in your browser — the file is never uploaded.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
